4 افشاهُ He revealed, disclosed, or divulged, it, (S, MA, Msb, K,) and spread it; (S, * Msb, K;) namely, a thing, (Msb,) or a secret, (MA,) or information, news, or tidings, (S, K,) and a man's beneficence, or bounty. (K.) ―
-b2- افشى ٱللّٰهُ ضَيْعَتَهُ, occurring in a trad., means God made, or may God make, his means of subsistence to be abundant. (TA in art. ضيع.) ＝
-A2- And افشى, said of a man, He had numerous cattle, (T, K, TA,) such as sheep or goats, and camels, &c., pasturing at large, (K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
